verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins keeps user-authored skills and plugins as plain directories in open, documented formats: SKILL.md built on the open agent skills standard, and a portable Agent Plugins plugin.json schema. A hands-on probe confirmed third-party tooling can install these skills outside Codex, so this content is not locked in and is easy to take elsewhere. However, the evidence shows no export feature for a user's broader data, so only part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented 'export all my data' mechanism, export of installed-plugin, connector and account state, and any guidance on leaving or deleting an account.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Skills build on the open agent skills standard.
A skill is a directory with a `SKILL.md` file plus optional scripts and references.
For a portable Agent Plugins package, add `plugin.json` at the plugin root and declare the Agent Plugins schema.
the catalog's skills are plain portable folders that third-party tooling can install, not a Codex-locked format.
